function.name: searchBooks
function.description: Find library books by author, genre, year or update instant.

filter.description: Optional flat filter object with keys author (string, copy exactly), genre (one of: novel, essays, poetry, reference, comics), year (integer 1800..2030); omitted keys are not applied.

genre.description: Genre; one of: novel, essays, poetry, reference, comics

updatedAfter.description: Only books updated at/after this instant; full instant YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM with zone Z or +HH:MM, never date-only

limit.description: Max rows, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all

function.name: getBook
function.description: Read one book record by its identifier.

bookId.description: Book identifier; opaque identifier, copy exactly, e.g. BK-101

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of record keys to return; allowed keys: bookId, title, author, genre, year, updatedAt; omit for full records

function.name: listLoans
function.description: List loans, optionally only one status and/or loans open on a date.

status.description: Loan status; omit for all; one of: on_loan, returned, overdue

openOn.description: Only loans open on this date; date-only YYYY-MM-DD, never a timestamp

limit.description: Max rows to return, non-negative integer 0..50; omit for all rows

function.name: getBorrower
function.description: Read a borrower profile and all linked loan records by numeric id. The fields projection restricts the profile only; linked loans include all stored statuses.

fields.description: Optional projection: subset of borrower keys to return; allowed keys: borrowerId, name; omit for full record
